facts.business: Chambal Breweries & Distilleries Limited is engaged in the trading and retailing of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), beer, and country liquor, though it did not undertake any business activity or generate revenue from principal operations during FY 2025-26.

segments.name: Trading of Alcoholic Beverages (IMFL, Beer, Country Liquor)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company aims to optimize cost structures, identify growth channels, and capitalize on emerging market opportunities. Barring unforeseen circumstances, it remains cautiously optimistic about enhancing profitability and stakeholder value in the coming years.

auditor.name: Lokesh Maheshwari & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations, adverse remarks or disclaimers in the Audit Report as on 31st March 2026.

facts.related_party_note: During the financial year under review, the Company has not entered into any contract or arrangement with related parties as referred to in Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013.
